# To My Girlfriend Who Never Was

[Silas Bambil · August 2023]{.meta}

Dear my girlfriend who never was,

It is your birthday, and I thought I would take the opportunity to tell you a few things that deserve to be said more often than once a year. I could simply wish you a happy birthday and leave it at that, but I would rather use the occasion to remind you how much you mean to me. After all, birthdays are not only occasions for celebrating the passage of another year in someone's life. They also give the people fortunate enough to know that person an opportunity to express how grateful they are that such a person exists.

I must admit that there is something rather amusing about addressing you as my girlfriend when the most important detail about that description is that you are not. Although I think the title would suit us quite nicely, I suppose I will have to content myself with being your friend. And what a lovely privilege that is. There are people whose importance in our lives cannot quite be explained by the titles we give our relationships with them. You are one such person to me. Being able to call you my friend is already something I am genuinely grateful for, even if my ambitions extend a little beyond that.

I thank God for bringing you into my life. And when I thank Him, I am not merely expressing gratitude for the possibility of you becoming my girlfriend. I am grateful that I got to know you. There is something wonderful about encountering someone whose character you genuinely admire, whose presence you appreciate, and whose happiness becomes something you sincerely care about. Knowing you has given me another reason to appreciate God's goodness. Whatever our relationship eventually becomes, I consider having had the opportunity to know someone like you a beautiful thing in itself.

You are, quite frankly, the prettiest woman I have ever known. I appreciate that I might be a little biased, but I have no particular interest in correcting that bias. What makes my admiration for you even more meaningful, however, is how much there is about you to admire beyond your beauty. You are intelligent without losing your humility, strong without losing your gentleness, and genuinely down-to-earth. I admire your decency, your sincerity, and the quiet beauty of your character. I could have been perfectly content with discovering that you were beautiful, but God apparently decided to make you interesting in several other respects as well.

I particularly admire the woman you are in relation to your faith. You are prayerful and godly, and those are qualities I find incredibly beautiful in you. I admire your humility and submissiveness, not because I regard either as an absence of strength or independence, but because I appreciate the grace with which those qualities coexist with your intelligence and strength of character. There is so much about you that I find desirable in a woman. I do not mean that I expect you to be without imperfections. I simply mean that when I think about the kind of woman I would love to share my life with, I find so many of those qualities in you. You are the girl of my dreams.

One of the things I genuinely hope for is that I will always have a place in your life. I want to always be your friend and even more. I suppose there is little point in pretending otherwise when I have already addressed this letter to my girlfriend who never was. Nevertheless, I would never want my desire for something more to make me ungrateful for the friendship I already have with you. I appreciate you for considerably more than the possibility of a romantic relationship. You are someone I genuinely want to know, care about, and see happy. The prospect of being your boyfriend would simply give me another rather delightful reason to do those things.

I don't want to lose you for anything in the world. I say that because your presence in my life means something to me that I would find difficult to regard casually. I cherish our friendship, and I hope it remains something beautiful for both of us. I cannot tell you what the future holds, nor do I think affection gives me the right to determine yours. But I can tell you what I hope for. I hope that whatever life brings, there will always be room for us to appreciate each other and that I will continue to have reasons to celebrate the wonderful person you are.

Thank you for making me a good friend and above all a better person. I find it remarkable that one of the beautiful things about knowing somebody can be what happens to the person you are becoming. Caring about you makes me want to become more thoughtful, more considerate, and more conscious of how I treat the people who matter to me. I want to become someone whose friendship is as valuable to you as yours is to me. And while I appreciate all the qualities that make you such a wonderful woman, I am equally grateful for the desire knowing you gives me to become a better man.

On your birthday, I wish you long life, God's protection, divine health, happiness, and fulfilment. I pray that God continues to watch over you and that the years ahead bring you beautiful experiences and countless reasons to be grateful. I hope you find happiness in the things that matter to you and that you become everything you genuinely desire to be. There is something particularly lovely about wishing good things for someone whose happiness matters to you. I hope life gives you as many reasons to smile as the thought of having you in my life gives me.

You may not be my girlfriend, but I certainly have enough reasons to celebrate you today. I am grateful for your existence, delighted by the person you are, and rather pleased that somewhere in this enormous world, God allowed our lives to cross. I hope you never underestimate how beautiful you are, both in the things that are immediately apparent and in the qualities that make knowing you such a pleasure. And should I require a more appropriate title for next year's birthday message, I certainly would not consider that an inconvenience.

I love and cherish you 3000.

Happy birthday, babe. I love you. ❤️

With love,

SB

*The original birthday message that inspired this open letter was written on 31 August 2023.*
